import bisect, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/tests')
from reference import compositions, _product, pareto
U=1<<128
WIDTH=(16,8,4); LANES=(4,8,16)

starts=[0, 0xd6440de2f0dec6823 if False else int.from_bytes(bytes.fromhex('d6440de2f'+'0dec6823'.rjust(8,'0')),'big')]
# compute properly
base = int('d6440de2f0dec6823',16) if False else None
p = 'd644:de2f:dec:6823::'
S = int(ipaddress_mod := __import__('ipaddress').IPv6Address(p))
starts=[0,S,S+(1<<64)]
hops=[None,0,None]
bursts=[(1,[0xe2e0c40a29ca862d6e455f50416e99b0 if False else int(__import__('ipaddress').IPv6Address('e2e:c40a:29ca:862d:6e45:5f5:416e:99b0')),
            int(__import__('ipaddress').IPv6Address('b153:d69c:3e01:aaa6:9949:8ac4:482c:c78e'))]),
        (13,[S])]
C=2; hit=1; miss=12; dec=[2,2,1]
R=3
weights=[0]*R; hitsets=[]
for repeat,addrs in bursts:
    runs=[bisect.bisect_right(starts,a)-1 for a in addrs]
    for k in runs: weights[k]+=repeat
    hitsets.append((repeat,set(runs)))
print('weights',weights,'hitsets',hitsets)
wsum=[0]
for x in weights: wsum.append(wsum[-1]+x)
def Q(i,j): return wsum[j]-wsum[i]
def T(i,j): return sum(rep for rep,hs in hitsets if any(i<=k<j for k in hs))
def ok(i,s,m):
    if m==0: return True
    spread=starts[i+s-1]-starts[i]
    return spread < (1<<(64 if m==1 else 32))
memo={}
def options(i,s):
    if (i,s) in memo: return memo[(i,s)]
    triples=[]
    if s<=8:
        for m in range(3):
            if not ok(i,s,m): continue
            P=(32+s*WIDTH[m]+63)//64
            coeff=(s+LANES[m]-1)//LANES[m]+dec[m]
            base=coeff*Q(i,i+s)
            for cached in (0,1):
                work=base+P*(hit if cached else miss)*T(i,i+s)
                triples.append((work,P,P if cached else 0,[('leaf',i,s,m,cached)]))
    if s>=2:
        for b in range(2,min(9,s)+1):
            for m in range(3):
                if not ok(i,s,m): continue
                P=(32+4*b+(b-1)*WIDTH[m]+63)//64
                coeff=((b-1)+LANES[m]-1)//LANES[m]+dec[m]
                nb=coeff*Q(i,i+s)
                nodes=[(P*(hit if cached else miss)*T(i,i+s)+nb,P if cached else 0,b,m,cached) for cached in (0,1)]
                for comp in compositions(s,b):
                    parts=[];at=i
                    for span in comp:
                        parts.append(options(at,span)); at+=span
                    for combo in _product(parts):
                        for nw,nres,b_,m_,cached_ in nodes:
                            triples.append((nw+sum(x[0] for x in combo),P+sum(x[1] for x in combo),nres+sum(x[2] for x in combo),
                                            [('int',i,s,b_,m_,cached_,[x[3] for x in combo])]))
    out=pareto4(triples)
    memo[(i,s)]=out
    return out
def pareto4(items):
    items.sort(key=lambda x:(x[0],x[1],x[2]))
    out=[]
    for it in items:
        work,pages,resident,tree=it
        dom=False
        for o in out:
            if o[0]<=work and o[1]<=pages and o[2]<=resident: dom=True;break
        if dom: continue
        out=[x for x in out if not (work<=x[0] and pages<=x[1] and resident<=x[2])]
        out.append(it)
    return out
best=None
for work,pages,resident,tree in options(0,R):
    if resident>C: continue
    if best is None or (work,pages+2)<best[0]: best=((work,pages+2),tree)
print('BEST',best)
PYEOF
